call_purpose: You wanted to connect your payment gateway, but you could not log in to the gateway dashboard.
objective: Connect your payment gateway to FlexiFunnels.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you reset your password from the gateway's login page and were then able to log in to the gateway dashboard.
You opened Settings, Payments in FlexiFunnels, chose your gateway, pasted the keys from the gateway dashboard and saved, and you confirmed it showed as connected.

customer_next_steps.text: Run one test order from your checkout page to confirm payments work.
